facts.fact: HCN's director of digital governance says the national interoperability system, the backbone for data exchange between ministries, public bodies and public-service institutions, is in service and ministries have been feeding it data since 2025, mostly front-end databases.

Presidential decree 25-320 of 31 December 2025 set up a national data governance system, with data classification and data-source indexing references, launched under the national digital transformation strategy 2025-2030.
The National Committee for Data Governance, made up of the heads of the sectoral committees, has been installed to oversee implementation of the national data governance system across all sectors.
The document describes the national authority for protection of personal data (ANPDP) as the body legally empowered to audit and control personal data processing within the data governance system.
The document cites law 18-07, as amended and supplemented, on protection of personal data, among the national legal framework behind the data classification reference.

Presidential decree 25-320 of 31 December 2025 established a national data governance system with a five-level data classification (public to top secret, the highest not exchangeable) that ministries are now applying, and treats data as a sovereign asset.

HCN's director of digital governance says the national digital transformation strategy 2025-2030, Algérie numérique 2030, has been launched and adopted, and the data governance system is part of its implementation.
The strategy named Algérie numérique 2030 runs from 2025 to 2030.

Presidential decree 25-320 of 31 December 2025 set up the national data governance system including the national interoperability system as the backbone of data exchange between ministries and public bodies.
